meta.schema: Leonida Ledger enrichment v1 — three fields merged into each base trophy record at load, keyed by trophy id.
meta.confidenceRule: Confirmed — Official List: the official description fully states the requirement. Verified — Cross-checked: name and grade cross-checked across both cited lists, but the exact target or trigger rests on tracker hints or guide reporting. Reported — Unconfirmed: a single reported candidate whose requirement is not established; used for Positive Mental Attitude only.
